beats.say: Raye is only 28, and her song just hit a billion streams. Yes, that track on your wedding playlist broke records worldwide.
‘Where Is My Husband!’ has surpassed a billion Spotify streams. It was released in September 2025.
Mike Sabath co-wrote the song with Raye. The duo crafted its pop-savvy sound.
Raye, 28, continues to dominate the pop scene.
Next time you hear it, remember that billion stream surprise. Could you ever have imagined a pop hit becoming a love song staple?
